groups.defect: Duplicate Attendee rows can be inserted. The server schema and handler never dedupe guests within a single request (the uniqueness refine is client-only). Separately, the read-filter-then-createMany sequence is a TOCTOU race, so two concurrent requests can both insert the same new guest.

answer.reasoning: s_9e2d0fde and s_c8acf696 report the same defect: the server schema in addGuests.schema.ts accepts the same email twice in one request, and uniqueGuests only filters out emails that are already attendees. That pairing is clear. s_c8acf696 also says, in its WHY, that two concurrent requests both pass the existence check before either writes (TOCTOU). That is the whole of s_6180295c, so the three form one group by chaining. The weak point is that s_c8acf696 states the race in a single clause and its proposed fix does not address it, so someone could read it as context rather than a reported defect. That makes this a judgment call. I still count it as reported because it is stated as a problem that causes duplicate rows. The members point at different files (the schema vs. handler lines 74-106), so the kind is cross_location. The merged comment has to cover two defects (duplicates inside one request and the race between concurrent requests), so needsUnifiedComment is true.
